SELECT 
CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME AS LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, 
CFRS.OPDIV_NAME AS OPDIV_NAME, 
LGR.ROW_WID AS ROW_WID
FROM W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D CFRS, W_LEDGER_D LGR
WHERE CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME = LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME
AND LGR.ROW_WID <> 3
AND LGR.DELETE_FLG = 'N'
GROUP BY CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, CFRS.OPDIV_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID

SELECT 
LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME AS LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, 
LGR.ROW_WID AS ROW_WID
FROM W_LEDGER_D LGR
WHERE LGR.DELETE_FLG = 'N'
AND LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME IS NOT NULL
AND LGR.ROW_WID <> 3
GROUP BY LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID

SELECT main_account AS MAIN_ACCOUNT,
    --   nvl(ATA, 'X') AS ATA,
    --   NVL(sub_account, 'X') AS SUB_ACCOUNT,
       OPDIV AS OPDIV
  FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D
 WHERE (main_account)  IN
           (Select main_account from ( Select main_account, count(*) FROM 
           (SELECT A.main_account, B.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, COUNT (*)
                FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D A, W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D B
                WHERE NVL(SUBSTR(OPDIV, 1, INSTR(OPDIV, '-')-1), OPDIV) = B.OPDIV_NAME
                AND (A.FR_ENTITY = '7500'
               OR A.FR_ENTITY IS NULL)
            GROUP BY A.main_account, B.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME
              )
              group by main_account
              having count(*) =1))
              group by main_account,  OPDIV
              --ATA, SUB_ACCOUNT,

SELECT main_account AS MAIN_ACCOUNT,
       nvl(ATA, 'X') AS ATA,
       NVL(sub_account, 'X') AS SUB_ACCOUNT,
       opdiv AS OPDIV
  FROM (SELECT a.opdiv,
               a.main_account,
               A.ATA,
               A.sub_account,
               ROW_NUMBER ()
                   OVER (PARTITION BY a.opdiv,
                                      a.main_account,
                                      A.ATA,
                                      A.sub_account
                         ORDER BY B.EXPIRATION_DATE)    rn
          FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D a, w_treasury_symbol_d b
         WHERE     (a.main_account) IN
                       (SELECT main_account
                          FROM (  SELECT main_account, COUNT (*)
                                    FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D
                                GROUP BY main_account
                                  HAVING COUNT (*) > 1))
               AND a.TREASURY_SYMBOL = NVL (b.tas, b.treasury_symbol)
               AND a.opdiv = DECODE (b.ledger_wid, 2, 'CMS', b.PSC_OPDIV)
               AND NVL (b.CANCELLATION_DATE, SYSDATE + 1) > SYSDATE
               AND (a.FR_ENTITY = '7500'
               OR a.FR_ENTITY IS NULL))
 WHERE rn = 1
table_attributes.Lookup condition: MAIN_ACCOUNT = i_TP_MAIN_ACCOUNT AND ATA = i_ATA_LKP AND SUB_ACCOUNT = i_SUB_ACCOUNT_LKP

MPLT_CURCY_CONVERSION_RATES_ToGlobalCurr.description: This mapplet is responsible for getting the correct exchange rates for a date chosen, where a currency conversion to any of the three possible global currencies is involved.

inner_transformations.name: LKP_W_EXCH_RATE
inner_transformations.description: For a given "from currency code" and exchange date, this lookup finds the conversion rate to the three possible global currency codes.

table_attributes.Lookup Sql Override:
SELECT
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.EXCH_RATE AS EXCH_RATE,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.FROM_CURCY_CD AS FROM_CURCY_CD,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.TO_CURCY_CD AS TO_CURCY_CD,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.START_DT AS START_DT,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.END_DT AS END_DT,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.RATE_TYPE AS RATE_TYPE,
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
FROM
     W_EXCH_RATE_G,
     (
     SELECT 
          GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE REQUIRED_TO_CURR, 
          GLOBAL1_RATE_TYPE REQUIRED_RATE_TYPE, 
          DATASOURCE_NUM_ID DSN 
     FROM 
          W_GLOBAL_CURR_G 
     UNION 
     SELECT 
          GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE REQUIRED_TO_CURR, 
          GLOBAL2_RATE_TYPE REQUIRED_RATE_TYPE, 
          DATASOURCE_NUM_ID DSN 
     FROM 
          W_GLOBAL_CURR_G 
     UNION 
     SELECT 
          GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE REQUIRED_TO_CURR, 
          GLOBAL3_RATE_TYPE REQUIRED_RATE_TYPE, 
          DATASOURCE_NUM_ID DSN 
      FROM 
          W_GLOBAL_CURR_G
     ) GLOBAL_CURR 
WHERE 
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.TO_CURCY_CD = GLOBAL_CURR.REQUIRED_TO_CURR AND 
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.RATE_TYPE = GLOBAL_CURR.REQUIRED_RATE_TYPE AND 
     W_EXCH_RATE_G.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = GLOBAL_CURR.DSN
table_attributes.Lookup condition: FROM_CURCY_CD = IN_FROM_CURCY_CD AND TO_CURCY_CD = IN_TO_CURCY_CD AND START_DT <= IN_EXCH_DT AND END_DT > IN_EXCH_DT AND RATE_TYPE = IN_RATE_TYPE AND DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = IN_DATASOURCE_NUM_ID

ports.name: DOC_TO_LOC_EXCH_RATE_VAR
ports.expression:
IIF(ISNULL(DOC_TO_LOC_EXCH_RATE),
IIF(LOC_CURR_CODE = DOC_CURR_CODE, 1.0, 
IIF(DOC_CURR_CODE = 'STAT', 1.0,
IIF(ISNULL(LOC_CURR_CODE), NULL, :LKP.LKP_W_EXCH_RATE(DOC_CURR_CODE,LOC_CURR_CODE,EXCH_DT,LOC_RATE_TYPE_VAR,DATASOURCE_NUM_ID)))),
DOC_TO_LOC_EXCH_RATE)

ports.name: DOC_TO_GLOBAL1_EXCH_RATE_VAR
ports.expression:
IIF(ISNULL(GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE), NULL,
IIF(GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE = DOC_CURR_CODE, 1.0,  
IIF(DOC_CURR_CODE = 'STAT', 1.0,
IIF(GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE = LOC_CURR_CODE, DOC_TO_LOC_EXCH_RATE_VAR,
:LKP.LKP_W_EXCH_RATE(DOC_CURR_CODE, GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE, EXCH_DT,GLOBAL1_RATE_TYPE, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID)))))

ports.expression:
IIF(ISNULL(GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE), NULL,
IIF(GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE = GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE, DOC_TO_GLOBAL1_EXCH_RATE_VAR,
IIF(GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE = DOC_CURR_CODE, 1.0,
IIF(DOC_CURR_CODE = 'STAT', 1.0,  
IIF(GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE = LOC_CURR_CODE, DOC_TO_LOC_EXCH_RATE_VAR,
:LKP.LKP_W_EXCH_RATE(DOC_CURR_CODE, GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE, EXCH_DT,GLOBAL2_RATE_TYPE, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID))))))

ports.name: DOC_TO_GLOBAL3_EXCH_RATE_VAR
ports.expression:
IIF(ISNULL(GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE), NULL,
IIF(GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE = GLOBAL1_CURR_CODE, DOC_TO_GLOBAL1_EXCH_RATE_VAR,
IIF(GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE = GLOBAL2_CURR_CODE, DOC_TO_GLOBAL2_EXCH_RATE_VAR,
IIF(GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE = DOC_CURR_CODE, 1.0, 
IIF(DOC_CURR_CODE = 'STAT', 1.0,

:LKP.LKP_W_EXCH_RATE(DOC_CURR_CODE, GLOBAL3_CURR_CODE, EXCH_DT,GLOBAL3_RATE_TYPE, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID)))))))

MPLT_GET_UOM_CONVERSIONS@28.name: MPLT_GET_UOM_CONVERSIONS
MPLT_GET_UOM_CONVERSIONS@28.description:
Mapplet: MPLT_GET_UOM_CONVERSIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
This mapplet is responsible for getting the UOM Conversion Rates for the Standard and Primary UOM from the UOM Conversion Rate table W_UOM_CONVERSION_G. 

Input:
--------
DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
PRODUCT_ID (Integration Id of W_PRODUCT_D)
INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D (Integration Id of W_INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D)
FROM_UOM_CODE

Output:
-----------
DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
PRODUCT_ID (Integration Id of W_PRODUCT_D)
INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D (Integration Id of W_INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D)
FROM_UOM_CODE
STANDARD_UOM_CONVERSION_RATE
STANDARD_UOM_CODE
PRIMARY_UOM_CONVERSION_RATE
PRIMARY_UOM_CODE

Logic:
---------
1. The Input ports DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, PRODUCT_ID are used to lookup W_PRODUCT_D table and get the latest STANDARD_UOM_CODE.
2. The input ports DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INVENTORY_PRODUCT_ID are used to lookup W_INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D table and get the latest PRIMARY_UOM_CODE.
3. The input ports DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, FROM_UOM_CODE and STANDARD_UOM_CODE  are used to lookup W_UOM_CONVERSION_G table and get the Conversion_rate for Standard UOM.
4. The input ports DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INVENTORY_PRODUCT_ID, FROM_UOM_CODE and PRIMARY_UOM_CODE  are used to lookup W_UOM_CONVERSION_G table and get the Conversion_rate for Primary UOM.
5. If Step 3 returns NULL, Set the STANDARD_UOM_CODE to FROM_UOM_CODE and STANDARD_UOM_CONVERSION to 1.00.
6. If Step 4 returns NULL, Set the PRIMARY_UOM_CODE to STANDARD_UOM_CODE and PRIMARY_UOM_CONVERSION to STANDARD_UOM_CONVERSION.

table_attributes.Lookup condition: DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = IN_DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND INTEGRATION_ID = IN_INVPROD_INTEGRATION_ID AND CURRENT_FLG = IN_CURRENT_FLG
DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = IN_DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND INTEGRATION_ID = IN_INVPROD_INTEGRATION_ID AND CURRENT_FLG = IN_CURRENT_FLG
INTEGRATION_ID = IN_PROD_INTEGRATION_ID AND DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = IN_DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND CURRENT_FLG = IN_CURRENT_FLG

MPLT_LKP_W_SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_D@33.name: MPLT_LKP_W_SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_D
MPLT_LKP_W_SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_D@33.description:
This Mapplet is created to handle the logic to resolve supplier product foreign key.

The Supplier product can be defined for the entire supplier or for a specific supplier site. Also it can be defined for the entire operating unit or for a specific plant. Therefore there are different combinations we need to try to resolve the foreign key. 

The precedence of the key resolution is the strictest combination first and lest strict last.

      IIF(ISNULL(INP_CANCEL_FLAG), 'N', INP_CANCEL_FLAG) = 'Y'
     OR 
     IIF(ISNULL(AUTHORIZATION_STATUS),'999',AUTHORIZATION_STATUS) = 'CANCELLED' 
     OR 
    TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE = 'INTERNAL',
      'N',
      'Y'
     )

ports.name: REQ_APPROVED_FLAG
ports.expression:
IIF( 
        IIF(ISNULL(MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG),'N',MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG ) ='N'
        AND
       IIF(ISNULL(INP_CANCEL_FLAG),'N',INP_CANCEL_FLAG)='N'
       AND
      TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE != 'INTERNAL'
      AND
       IIF(ISNULL(AUTHORIZATION_STATUS), '999', AUTHORIZATION_STATUS)
              ='APPROVED'
       AND 
       NOT ISNULL(APPROVAL_DT)
        , 'Y'
       , 'N'
       )

ports.name: FULFILLMENT_TRACKING_FLG
ports.expression:
IIF(
      IIF(ISNULL(INP_LINE_LOCATION_ID_PO), MATCHING_BASIS, INP_MATCHING_BASIS_PO) = 'AMOUNT' --Amt based
     OR
      IIF(ISNULL(INP_CONSIGNED_FLAG), 'N', INP_CONSIGNED_FLAG) ='Y' --Consigned Flag
     OR
     IIF(ISNULL(INP_VMI_FLAG),'N',INP_VMI_FLAG) ='Y'  --VMI Flag
     OR
     IIF(ISNULL(INP_PROGRESS_PAYMENT_FLAG),'N',INP_PROGRESS_PAYMENT_FLAG) = 'Y'    --CWP
     ,'N'
     ,'Y'
     )

ports.name: SOURCING_FLG
ports.expression:
IIF( ISNULL(INP_LINE_LOCATION_ID),
		IIF(INP_AT_SOURCING_FLAG ='Y'
       		OR
            		 (INP_REQS_IN_POOL_FLAG='Y'
              	AND IIF(ISNULL(INP_ON_RFQ_FLAG),'N' ,INP_ON_RFQ_FLAG) ='Y'
               AND ISNULL(INP_AUCTION_HEADER_ID))
     		  ,'Y'
       ,IIF(INP_REQS_IN_POOL_FLAG='Y','N','P')
      	), NULL)

ports.name: RECEIVED_ON_DT
ports.expression:
IIF(IIF(ISNULL(INP_APPROVED_FLAG),'N',INP_APPROVED_FLAG) = 'Y'
     ,IIF(
              IIF(ISNULL(INP_RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG), 'N',  INP_RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG) ='N'
              AND
              IIF(ISNULL(INP_INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG), 'N', INP_INSPECTION_REQUIRED_FLAG) ='N'
              ,LEAST(IIF(ISNULL(INP_SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE)
                                       ,INP_CLOSED_FOR_INVOICE_DATE
                                       ,INP_SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE)
                               , INP_CLOSED_FOR_INVOICE_DATE)
             ,LEAST(IIF(ISNULL(INP_SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE)
                                       ,INP_CLOSED_FOR_RECEIVING_DATE
                                       ,INP_SHIPMENT_CLOSED_DATE)
                              , INP_CLOSED_FOR_RECEIVING_DATE)
             )
       )

ports.name: FULFILLMENT_STATUS_ID_V
ports.expression:
'PURCH_RQLNS~FULFILLMENT~'||
--Not applicable
IIF(APPLICABLE_FLAG='N'
       ,'NOT_APPLICABLE'
       --UnApproved
      ,IIF(REQ_APPROVED_FLAG='N'
              AND APPLICABLE_FLAG='Y'
              ,'UNAPPROVED~NOT_APPLICABLE'
             --Approved, Unprocessed
             ,IIF(REQ_APPROVED_FLAG='Y' AND ISNULL(PO_APPROVED_ON_DT)
                     ,'UNPROCESSED~'||
                                                                 IIF(ISNULL(CREATION_DATE1) AND SOURCING_FLG != 'P'
                       	                                            ,IIF(SOURCING_FLG = 'N','PENDING_BUYER_WORKBENCH','PENDING_SOURCING')
                                                                     ,IIF(ISNULL(PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT) ,'PENDING_BUYER_SUBMIT'
                                                                 ,IIF(ISNULL(PO_APPROVED_ON_DT),'PENDING_PO_APPROVAL')
                                                                      )
                                                                 )
                    ,IIF(REQ_APPROVED_FLAG ='Y' AND NOT(ISNULL(PO_APPROVED_ON_DT)) --Processed
                    ,IIF(FULFILLMENT_TRACKING_FLG = 'Y'
                        ,IIF(ISNULL(RECEIVED_ON_DT),'UNFULFILLED~FULFILLMENT_TRACKED','FULFILLED~NOT_APPLICABLE')           
                        ,'UNFULFILLED~FULFILLMENT_NOT_TRACKED'
                        )
                    ,'NOT_APPLICABLE'
                    )
                    
                    )
             )

)

table_attributes.Sql Query:
WITH CURRENCY_LST AS
     (SELECT NVL(FSP.ORG_ID, -99) ORG_ID,
             GSB.CURRENCY_CODE
     FROM    FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL FSP,
             GL_SETS_OF_BOOKS GSB
     WHERE   FSP.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID = GSB.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
     )
     ,
     PR_DATE AS
     (SELECT  PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_ID,
              MAX(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'APPROVE'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_APPROVED_DATE,
              MIN(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'SUBMIT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'IMPORT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_SUBMIT_DATE
     FROM     PO_ACTION_HISTORY
     WHERE    PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQUISITION'
     AND      PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE IN ('APPROVE',
                                                'SUBMIT' ,
                                                'IMPORT')
     GROUP BY OBJECT_ID
     )

PO_HEADERS_ALL.ATTRIBUTE1,

	   PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.ATTRIBUTE1,
	   PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.ATTRIBUTE15,
	   PO_RELEASES_ALL.ATTRIBUTE15,
PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.ACCRUE_ON_RECEIPT_FLAG
       FROM 
	 (
	    (SELECT
		    LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	    FROM    PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL,
		    PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE   LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND     HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    
	    UNION ALL
	    
	    SELECT
  		   LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	    FROM   PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL,
		   PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE  LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND    HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    AND    LINES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE     >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    )
	 
	 UNION
	 
	 SELECT
  		LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	 FROM   (	 
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_RELEASES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID       = PO_RELEASES_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID
	 AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 AND    PO_RELEASES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 
	 UNION ALL
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_HEADERS_ALL                     ,
		PO_LINES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID  = PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID
	 AND    PO_LINES_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID = PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID
	 AND
		(
		       PO_HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
	 
	 UNION ALL
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
		LOCATIONS_TMP,
		PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL
	 WHERE  
	 LINES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE  < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 AND   LINES_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = LOCATIONS_TMP.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 ) TMP, 
 PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL, 
 PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, 
 PO_RELEASES_ALL, 
 PO_LINES_ALL, 
 PO_HEADERS_ALL, 
 PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL , 
 PR_DATE, 
 CURRENCY_LST,
 PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS
 WHERE 
 PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID(+)
 AND PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PR_DATE.OBJECT_ID(+)
 AND PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID               = PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID(+)
 AND PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID            = PO_RELEASES_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID(+)
 AND PO_LINES_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID                      = PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID(+)
 AND PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
 AND PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.ROWID                 = TMP.RW
 AND CURRENCY_LST.ORG_ID                            = NVL(PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL.ORG_ID,-99)
 AND PO_HEADERS_ALL.STYLE_ID                        = PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS.STYLE_ID(+)

table_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT 
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.CREATION_DATE,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.CREATED_BY,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
  HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_NAME,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_TYPE,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_NAME,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_BRANCH_NAME,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.ADDRESS_LINE1,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.ADDRESS_LINE2,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.ADDRESS_LINE3,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.CITY,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.STATE,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.COUNTRY,
  PARTY_REL.PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
  PARTY_REL.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_NUMBER,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.INSTITUTION_TYPE,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.BANK_NUMBER,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.COUNTY,
  CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
  CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE,
 CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.PRIMARY_FLAG,
CEBV_BANK_ACCOUNTS.END_DATE
FROM 
  (SELECT  bankorgprofile.organization_name bank_name,
               bankorgprofile.bank_or_branch_number bank_number,
               branchparty.party_id bank_branch_id,
               branchparty.party_name bank_branch_name,
               branchparty.address1 address_line1,
               branchparty.address2 address_line2,
               branchparty.address3 address_line3,
               branchparty.city city,
               branchparty.province county,
               branchparty.state state,
               branchparty.country country,
               bankca.class_code institution_type,
               TO_DATE(NULL) last_update_date            
          FROM hz_organization_profiles bankorgprofile,
               hz_code_assignments      bankca,
               hz_parties               branchparty,
               hz_organization_profiles branchorgprofile,
               hz_code_assignments      branchca,
               hz_relationships         brrel
         WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN TRUNC(bankorgprofile.effective_start_date) 
                                                               AND  NVL(TRUNC(bankorgprofile.effective_end_date), SYSDATE + 1)
           AND bankca.class_category = 'BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE'
           AND bankca.class_code IN ('BANK', 'CLEARINGHOUSE')
           AND bankca.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
           AND NVL(bankca.status, 'A') = 'A'
           AND bankca.owner_table_id = bankorgprofile.party_id
           AND branchparty.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
           AND branchparty.status = 'A'
           AND branchorgprofile.party_id = branchparty.party_id
           AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TRUNC(branchorgprofile.effective_start_date)
                                                        AND   NVL(TRUNC(branchorgprofile.effective_end_date), SYSDATE + 1)
           AND branchca.class_category = 'BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE'
           AND branchca.class_code IN ('BANK_BRANCH', 'CLEARINGHOUSE_BRANCH')
           AND branchca.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
           AND NVL(branchca.status, 'A') = 'A'
           AND branchca.owner_table_id = branchparty.party_id
           AND bankorgprofile.party_id = brrel.object_id
           AND brrel.relationship_type = 'BANK_AND_BRANCH'
           AND brrel.relationship_code = 'BRANCH_OF'
           AND brrel.status = 'A'
           AND brrel.subject_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
           AND brrel.subject_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
           AND brrel.object_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
           AND brrel.object_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
           AND brrel.subject_id = branchparty.party_id
  ) CEBV_BANK_BRANCHES,
  ( SELECT ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID bank_account_id,
       ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT bank_account_name_alt,
       ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM bank_account_number,
       ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE bank_account_type,
       'INTERNAL'  account_type,
       ACC.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME account_holder_name,
       ACC.BANK_BRANCH_ID bank_branch_id,
       ACC.CREATION_DATE creation_date,
       ACC.CREATED_BY created_by,
       ACC.LAST_UPDATE_DATE last_update_date,
       ACC.LAST_UPDATED_BY last_updated_by,
       ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME bank_account_name,
       ACC.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE agency_location_code,
       'Y' as primary_flag,
       ACC.end_date end_date
  FROM CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS ACC
UNION ALL
SELECT EB.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID bank_account_id,
       EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT bank_account_name_alt,
       EB.masked_bank_account_num bank_account_number,
       EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE bank_account_type,
       'EXTERNAL' account_type,
       TO_CHAR(NULL)       account_holder_name,
       EB.BRANCH_ID           bank_branch_id,
       EB.creation_date          creation_date,
       EB.created_by               created_by,
